text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't hold back at all! Train me 
strictly and whip me into shape for the 
big showdown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After promising to face off with Oguri 
Cap, I trained as hard as Tamamo Cross 
wanted, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Wait a sec! What d'ya 
mean, we barely get any days off this 
whole summer vacation?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, I thought I was gonna pass out.
choice_data_list: But you didn't collapse, did you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Course I did. Who d'ya think I am?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks to that, it turned into a 
great summer. Guess I'll be headin' home 
then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's steps toward the bus were 
positively bouncing, likely out of sheer 
satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And right before the bus departed—

text_block_list.name: Fans Surrounding the Bus
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross!! Go get 'em!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, Oguri Cap! O-gu-ri! 
O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah, what in the world?! From outside 
the bus...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Must be folks from the neighborhood. So 
many people came to see her off...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm grateful. The cheers of the fans 
always...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, aren't you making too much of a 
fuss? It's just the Tracen Academy 
training camp, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, this level of hype feels abnormal, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this takes me back. This atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. One of the glorious Triple Crown 
Umamusume, a free spirit who always walks 
her own path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While still stunned by the sudden, 
out-of-the-blue entrance of a legendary 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's not very often the training lodge 
gets this lively, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Except for just that one time, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There was a time like that. In the past, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, good luck. I'm sure this autumn will 
be tough for you as a Trainer too. Try to 
make the most of it despite the hardship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. saunters away with an airy 
detachment. I catch my breath slightly and 
take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. The passion 
between them, and the fervor surrounding 
them. —A truly special autumn was about to 
begin.
